blocks.text: Actress Sharmaine Arnaiz has finally achieved her longtime dream of becoming a licensed veterinarian after passing the November 2026 Veterinarians Computer-Based Licensure Examination on her second attempt. The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Monday, Nov. 9, that 1,083 out of 1,503 examinees passed the licensure examination, which was conducted from Nov. 4 to 6. Arnaiz, whose real name is Sharmila Velasco Pribhdas-Shahani, was listed among the passers posted on the website.
